detail: Full summary: Review-workflow verify agents mutated plugin/scripts/launch-server.sh in the LIVE working tree during the review — recurrence of the 07-24 incident (treat read-only review agents as capable of writes). Two agents, three edits: merge order flipped login-first→inherited-first, then the merge line deleted twice and later restored from a scratchpad backup in the flipped form. A test run racing the churn showed 23 spurious failures. File currently sits in agent-authored inherited-first state; restoration to login-first is pending workflow completion to avoid another race. Future review workflows over this repo should use isolation: worktree for any agent allowed to execute the code under review.
